# Tim's Tuinen - Professional Hovenier in West-Friesland

Tim's Tuinen is a professional gardening and landscaping business (hovenier) based in Midwoud, serving West-Friesland and Noord-Holland, Netherlands. We specialize in complete garden design, installation, and maintenance with a focus on quality craftsmanship and personal service.

## Services Offered

### Tuinaanleg (Garden Design & Installation)
Complete garden installation from design to completion. We handle grondbewerking (soil preparation), bestrating (paving), beplanting (planting), and gazonaanleg (lawn installation). Each project is custom-designed to match your wishes and the environment. Average project duration: 1-2 weeks for standard gardens (50-100m²), 3-4 weeks for larger projects.

### Tuinonderhoud (Garden Maintenance)
Professional garden maintenance services including maaien (mowing), snoeien (pruning), onkruid wieden (weeding), and seasonal maintenance. Available as one-time service, seasonal packages, or monthly subscriptions. We handle all green waste removal.

### Veranda & Terras (Veranda & Patio Construction)
Durable veranda construction and terrace installation using wood, composite, or tiles. Complete service including foundation work, drainage, and finishing. Materials suited to your garden and budget.

## Service Area & Response Time

**Primary Coverage** (10-15 minutes response time):
Midwoud, Medemblik, Wognum, Enkhuizen, Bovenkarspel, Zwaag, Berkhout, Hoogwoud, Oostwoud

**Extended Coverage**:
Hoorn, Alkmaar, and other locations throughout Noord-Holland. Available for larger projects in the greater Amsterdam region.

## Seasonal Recommendations

**Best seasons for tuinaanleg**: Spring (March-May) and Fall (September-November) when soil is workable and plants establish best. Summer projects possible with extra watering. Winter less suitable due to frost and wet ground.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**Q: How long does a garden installation project take?**
A: Standard backyard (50-100m²) takes 1-2 weeks. Larger projects with extensive groundwork may take 3-4 weeks. We provide clear timelines upfront.

**Q: Do you provide maintenance after installation?**
A: Yes! We offer maintenance subscriptions so your garden stays beautiful year-round. Available monthly, seasonally, or one-time.

**Q: What areas do you serve?**
A: Based in Midwoud, we're within 10-15 minutes of Medemblik, Wognum, Enkhuizen, and Bovenkarspel. We also serve Hoorn, Alkmaar, and other Noord-Holland locations.

**Q: Do I need to supply materials?**
A: No, we handle all material procurement including tegels (tiles), grond (soil), planten (plants), and schuttingmaterialen (fencing materials). Through our supplier connections in West-Friesland, we often secure competitive pricing.
